title: MutationOp
description: One normalized operation of a proposed metadata change, recorded with the published value it was computed against.

mutationOpType.description: set replaces a top-level field value; add and remove change one element of a list field identified by key.

changeOutcome.description: Where one change of the active revision stands: published, dropped by its reviewers, published by another change, not published because its reviewers could not agree, superseded by a newer published value of its field, or still waiting for a decision.

outcome.description: Reported with the active revision of a change request; not stored with the revision.

key.description: Element identity for add/remove: the string value itself, a tag FQN, a related glossary term with its relation type, an external reference endpoint with its name, or an entity reference id.

baseValue.description: JSON of the published field value this op was computed against. Set ops only.

value.description: JSON of the proposed field value (set) or of the element being added/removed.

gated.description: True when an approval workflow gates this field; false for a field carried along in a staged request.
